improvement: Raise compileSdk and targetSdk to 37 (Android 17); the plugin's behavior does not depend on the new target
Consistent localized resources, explicit plugin activation and validated release preparation
fix: Keep the plugin version date in English regardless of the build machine locale

hint: This release only improves documentation and supporting tooling; Pinyin conversion behavior and every script API remain unchanged
improvement: Reworked the README in 10 languages: added sections for usage, quick start, Pinyin style and option reference tables, script API, self check, FAQ, permissions and security, sibling plugin comparison and plugin interface

Upgraded the docs generator to the unified implementation shared across sibling plugins: `--check` drift detection, cross-language key and shape validation, fullwidth symbol rejection and version alignment checks
Brought the Plugin Center instructions (`plugin_instruction.md`) into the same multilingual JSON generation pipeline, eliminating double-source maintenance
Added the ROADMAP.md development roadmap and established bidirectional cross-references and a comparison with the sibling plugin Pinyin4j
Standardize the README layout and Gradle platform version management
Build verification rejects accidental native dependencies and produces a JSON report

feature: Pinyin plugin service: plugin ID `pinyin`, automatically discovered and invoked by AutoJs6 via `org.autojs.plugin.PINYIN`
Conversion API: `pinyin.convert(text, options)` returns a 2D candidate array carrying a `compact()` combination method, and `pinyin.simple(text)` returns a compact string
Dictionary lookup API: `pinyin.fromCodePoint(codePoint)` queries the reading record of a single character and `pinyin.fromPhrase(phrase)` queries phrase readings
Six Pinyin styles (`NORMAL` / `TONE` / `TONE2` / `TO3NE` / `INITIALS` / `FIRST_LETTER`) plus the surname mode (`SURNAME`)
Heteronym and segmentation support: bundled character, phrase and segmentation dictionaries plus an HMM model, with `segment` / `heteronym` / `group` options available on demand
Multilingual resources: plugin info and instructions available in 10 languages
README and CHANGELOG generated as multilingual Markdown from JSON sources via `.python/generate_markdown.py`
